goal: UNI-3306 PR 3 (revised): daily 90-day clean-up of goal analysis jobs via the generic script trigger on the live in-process cron_loop, because the cron modules are frozen. Finished and failed jobs are deleted 90 days after ended_at by a SQL function on the database clock, in bounded batches; active jobs are never deleted; a failed call is an error, never 'deleted 0'.
